title: Task completed: workspace report directory not gitignored
body:
Reports are now stored under .starfleet-ai/reports/ (git-tracked) instead of .starfleet-ai/var/comms/reports/.

**Changes in starfleetctl (pushed to master):**
- internal/reports/store.go: NewStore() now uses .starfleet-ai/reports/ (not var/)
- internal/reports/types.go: Updated doc comment
- .starfleet-ai/.gitignore: Added !/reports/ exception (negates /reports/ ignore)
- doc/reports.md: Updated storage paths documentation
- Reports persist to git like dashboard topics

**mpbt-workspace (mtx/agent-config):**
- .gitignore updated with !/reports/
- Dashboard topic 'task-workspace-report-directory-darf-nicht-gitignored' updated to done

**Verification:**
- Build passes (make)
- Bootstrap passes
- Web server restarts successfully
- Reports are now git-tracked and archived with the workspace
